==About==

A {{i|Red-Finned Mullet}} can be dried on a {{i|Drying Frame}} for 72 hours to make a {{i|Dried Red-Finned Mullet}}. Due to the current nature of the most recent Fish rework there is no reason to ever make a Dried Red-Finned Mullet.
